Thanks Olivia — received the W-9 and onboarding form, much appreciated. Looping in Kimberly (Procurement) and Marissa (Finance) so we can align on PO cadence and AP setup. A couple of quick asks from our side before we kick off the PO: 

1) Our standard POs for new vendors typically default to Net 60, which works here, but Finance has been running an early-pay pilot for a small set of suppliers to improve working capital. Would Fidelis be open to an early-pay option (15-day payment) in exchange for a 0.5% fee, or alternatively Net 30 for a 1% discount? We're proposing a 90-day pilot for a maximum of $75k of invoices to validate process overhead.

2) Can you confirm the exact bank details you will provide for ACH (account name, routing, bank name)? We will not store them in email but need them for the PO template and payment rails.

3) Any contract signature required or is PO sufficient? If DocuSign is needed we can include the PO terms there.

Next steps I propose: Procurement reviews onboarding checklist, Finance confirms early-pay pilot feasibility, and then we schedule a 20-min call with Fidelis to confirm PO terms.

On Wed, Dec 2, 2026 at 10:45 AM Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwoodinference.com> wrote:
> Thanks Olivia — received the W-9 and onboarding form...

Thanks for the ping. Procurement completed an initial intake against our AP onboarding checklist and the package is mostly complete — W-9 and vendor form look good. A few procurement notes and constraints: 

- Standard policy: Net 60 for new vendors unless Finance approves an exception. Exceptions are rare during initial onboarding because PO and ERP coding must be validated.
- Early-pay program: Finance is running a controlled pilot and will consider up to 2 vendors at a time. Approval criteria: clean 90-day invoice history (or projected volume), signed pilot addendum, and a cap on exposure.
- PO configuration: To support early-pay (15-day) we need PO terms flagged and a custom payment lane. That requires a ticket to the ERP team (2–3 business days) and a signed addendum from Fidelis approving early-pay fees.

Action items for this thread: 
1) Marissa — can you confirm if Finance will greenlight a 90-day pilot at the proposed fee levels and exposure cap ($75k)?
2) Dylan — please request bank account details via a secure portal (do not email full bank numbers). We can accept a DocuSign-secured bank detail sheet or an encrypted file share.
3) Olivia — if Fidelis is open to the pilot, please confirm the margin (0.5% for 15-day or 1% for Net 30) and confirm contract signer and preferred DocuSign email.

I've attached our AP_Onboarding_Checklist.pdf for reference.

Thanks,
Kimberly Park
Procurement Lead, Redwood Inference
kimberly.park@redwoodinference.com
